locked_stable: Each endpoint requires absolute speed error <= max(0.5 m/s, 10% command), absolute height error <= max(3 m, 10% command), abs(vz) <=1.5 m/s. Field AGL uses median ASL in first five seconds. All eligible intervals are summed per flight. The 20 s may comprise disjoint intervals.
straight_level: The nested sensitivity uses the project transient_cmu movement and ground-track guards. Each endpoint requires |vz| <= 0.8 m/s, |speed(t)-speed(t-1 s)|/1 s <0.30 m/s2, two resolved 0.75 s GNSS ground-track legs of at least 1 m with bend <=20 degrees. Kinematic history resets across gaps >0.5 s. Identical >=20 s eligibility and quadrature. Guard uses no power or field-fit outcome.
integration: Trapezoidal signed V*I on adjacent original times with both endpoints selected and 0<dt<=0.5 s. Divide the sum by the selected duration. Each held-out flight has equal weight in the field cell. The comparison measures mean electrical power over the eligible intervals.
native_window: Apply the corresponding kinematic mask to native ground truth inside the audited outbound measurement phase, plus a fresh acknowledged native pack ledger, bounded synchronized telemetry, and adjacent native pack packets <=0.30 s apart. Require >=20 s total in each treatment.
conditions: Exact nominal payload, AGL command and speed command. Wind, ambient temperature, route, starting SOC and density are unmatched across field and simulator flights. The aircraft-carried wind sensor measures relative airflow. This is a same-campaign check with sparse exact cells.
whole_phase: The held-out table includes the published whole cruise-phase mean for context. It includes changes of heading and speed. The steady comparison uses eligible kinematic intervals.
error_comparison: Absolute error to the field cell mean is |Pnative - mean(Pflight)|. Per-flight MAE is mean(|Pnative-Pflight|) across the identical field IDs. Negative on-minus-off errors mean closer agreement in these observations.
reproduction_with_native: Add --join-native after the native audit has written all accepted flights.
